summary: State objects: presets, properties, what reaches the renderer, per-family support and worked examples. Its central thesis is stale at TARGET: states use a shared payload with XNA's freeze-on-bind rule (assignment aliases, mutation after binding throws, copy construction gives a new mutable state), and MultiSampleAntiAlias, AddressW, the device MultiSampleMask, EasyGL reference stencil, mip-aware EasyGL filtering, sampler mip controls on twelve families, SDL_GPU and Software anisotropy and D3D12/Software scissor all changed. The site's guide covered presets and usage; identity, freeze, submission timing and per-family hook coverage are now on the state-objects deep dive, with an expansion in the guide.

concepts.text: The four state classes derive from GraphicsResource and keep their fields in a shared payload that also carries isBound and isDisposed flags.

concepts.text: The static presets are const, and their payloads are created already bound, which a C# static readonly field does not provide.

concepts.text: Claim that the mutable device getter returns a CPU copy whose mutation is not submitted: it returns an alias of the bound payload, and its setters throw.

concepts.text: Like Microsoft XNA, the device compares the incoming state's identity before applying it, so re-assigning the active state is a no-op (SOFTWARE-350).

concepts.text: Aliases share name, tag, device and disposed flag; disposing any alias disposes all and raises Disposing on each with the canonical object as sender.

Binding a disposed state throws ObjectDisposedException, except for the already-active state; a dirty state is re-applied and its disposal detected.
A state may be shared by several devices; each device caches its own identity.

Four presets with factors (Additive: SourceAlpha, SourceAlpha, One, One; AlphaBlend: One, One, InverseSourceAlpha x2; NonPremultiplied; Opaque).
Colour and alpha triples are independent, and four ColorWriteChannels masks, one per render-target slot, plus BlendFactor and MultiSampleMask complete the surface.

BlendFunction has five values: Add, Subtract, ReverseSubtract, Min, Max.
ColorWriteChannels is a flags enum with hand-written bitwise operators.
Native write-mask support varies: SDL_GPU honours masks but not MultiSampleMask, Metal throws for non-default masks, Canvas cannot express them.

concepts.text: Computed-equation tests are stronger evidence than property round trips.

concepts.text: Under Reach separate alpha blending and SourceAlphaSaturation as destination throw; Min and Max require One/One on both profiles.
A default-constructed BlendState is opaque, with all masks All, an opaque-white factor and MultiSampleMask -1.
Built content is premultiplied by cna-content by default (pairs with AlphaBlend); loose images decoded at run time are straight alpha (pair with NonPremultiplied).
SDL_GPU treats MultiSampleMask as a capability gap because SDL documents the sample-mask fields as reserved.
Three presets: Default (test and write), DepthRead (test only), None (neither).
DepthStencilState has sixteen properties, including two-sided stencil and four counter-clockwise variants.
CompareFunction and StencilOperation each have eight values.
Depth-function evidence is a five-case test (Always, Never, Less, LessEqual, Greater) registered for EasyGL and Vulkan; not a sweep of all eight.
Vulkan's depth-stencil apply once stored only two of its parameters and never enabled stencil; the repair writes full front and back stencil state and dynamic reference and masks.
Vulkan's depth-format selection once tried a stencil-less format first.
EasyGL windows were once created without requesting stencil bits, so stencil tests passed against zero bits.
concepts.note: Positive evidence: the platform GL context description carries stencilBits and SDL3/SDL2 set SDL_GL_STENCIL_SIZE (Sdl3GraphicsServices.cpp, Sdl2Platform.cpp), X11 and Wayland choose visuals/configs with stencil bits (X11GraphicsServices.cpp ChooseVisual, WaylandGraphicsServices.cpp EGL_STENCIL_SIZE).

The EasyGL SetReferenceStencil gap recorded in the Bible is absent at TARGET (override re-issues glStencilFunc).
